data.summary: Kinder Morgan (KMI) évoque l'IA principalement sous l'angle des risques (réglementation, sécurité, mauvais usage) dans son 10-K, avec une posture prudente.

evidence.quote: Generative artificial intelligence or other new technology could also create additional regulatory scrutiny and generate uncertainty around intellectual property ownership and/or licensing or use.
Technology (including artificial intelligence) is also subject to intentional misuse (by criminals, terrorists, or other bad actors).
